concerns.text: The plan states that *All SCs will be satisfied **with respect to the synthetic data**, thereby validating the pipeline* (see end of Phase & Task Breakdown). This makes the validation of the scientific hypothesis circular: the synthetic dataset is generated with a pre‑specified effect size, guaranteeing that permutation p‑values and ΔR² thresholds will be met. Consequently the analysis cannot provide empirical evidence about the real relationship between solar‑wind composition and geomagnetic indices, contradicting the original research question.
